findings.text: The commit changes how `merged_search_path` groups trusted and candidate package directories. It now merges a package family only when every original root that holds it ignores letter case, and it drops mixed-mode families from the merged view. A mixed-mode family now gets no merged view even when the spelling is the same in both roots, so a candidate sibling module in a package that the trusted library also supplies cannot be imported. `migration_check/prepare.py` uses this result for export and replay, so owner review required. Fix: have the owner review the new per-family rule and the loss of the merged view for mixed-mode families with the same spelling.

The `merged_search_path` docstring still says only that package names follow the original roots' case rules. It does not say that a package family is merged only when all its roots ignore letter case, or that a family with mixed case modes keeps the original search paths. Fix: add one sentence to the docstring that states the agreement rule and the fallback for mixed modes.
